title: Listing Flags
description: Review reports submitted by users for inappropriate listings.

help.title: About Listing flags
help.overview: A listing flag is a moderation report: a user marks a listing as inappropriate, spam, misleading, or other, with an optional comment. Only admins resolve or dismiss pending flags.

sections.title: Statuses
items: Pending — waiting for an admin decision.
Reviewed — the report was upheld; a resolution note is stored. The admin may also deactivate the listing.
Dismissed — the report was rejected; a resolution note is still required.

sections.title: Admin actions
items: Resolve sets status to reviewed and records the resolution text.
Optionally choose to deactivate the listed offer as part of resolve.
Dismiss sets status to dismissed with a resolution explanation.
sections.body: Resolve and dismiss only work while the flag is pending and not soft-deleted.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create records a new flag against a listing.
Edit can update reason and details while the listing itself stays fixed after create.
